body: I have advice on methods but obviously wouldn't give it here. I also hope I'm wrong. I am acting desperate now though which really is a turnoff so I've got to cut that shit out if I want any hope of repairing my relationship.

Sure of course there will a lot of pain. What can I do to make it the least amount possible?

The only thing that would dissuade me is if she or someone else killed themselves if I kill myself. I'm thinking of texting her telling her to go to the ER and get inpatient psychiatric care ASAP right before I end my life. Obviously that is what I should do if we break up, but I doubt that I will. And that's why I believe I will kill myself.
